ops_commands.preflight --design D --deployment SPEC [: PRECHECK.json (default beside SPEC, mode 0600); typed checks with blocks LAUNCH|PAIR|TEST; exit 0 only when no LAUNCH blocker
ops_commands.probe --json [--run-root R --data-root R: read-only host facts; run on each host by preflight/worker over ssh
ops_commands.init --design D --deployment SPEC --root: sealed EFFECTIVE_CONFIG.json, PLAN.json, queue; 5 validation units; no TEST unit
ops_commands.seal-long --root R --design L: seal the long design after init (identity fixed before any long fit)
ops_commands.deploy --root R --deployment SPEC [--no-: write campaign units (marker X-I6DMO-Campaign), daemon-reload, enable --now timers; --no-start enables nothing; --render-to calls no systemctl
ops_commands.render-bootstrap --deployment SPEC --roo: fills the template, mode 0700, refuses a path inside a Git work tree
ops_commands.tick --root R: finite advance: dependencies, automatic gates, readiness, finals only when READY, STATUS.json
ops_commands.worker --root R --host-role ROLE --once: admit + claim + supervise exactly one unit (or reattach/collect an orphan)
ops_commands.publish --root R [--no-mirror]: outbox exact-readback pass + local/second-host mirrors (runs under the warehouse EnvironmentFile)
ops_commands.gate --root R --name G --receipt JSON: record an external gate (DATA_PROVENANCE, SOFTWARE_TRACEABILITY, STRATEGY_OWNER_RULINGS); TEST reads refused
ops_commands.close --root R: CLOSE.json only with complete populations, gates, DELIVERED publication and VERIFIED mirrors

dag.short.fit: kind fit, gpu, QUEUED at init
dag.short.report: kind report, cpu, after short.fit (never fits)
dag.long.fit: kind fit, gpu, after short.report; WAIT_ARTIFACT until the long design is sealed
dag.pair.validation: kind pair, cpu, after short.report AND long.report; WAIT_OWNER_RULING until gates/STRATEGY_OWNER_RULINGS.json PASS
dag.final.short_refit / final.long_refit: kind final_refit, gpu, train [2021-01-01,2025-01-01); enumerated only by tick after TEST_READINESS READY
dag.final.pair_test: kind final_test, cpu, the only unit with test_open=true; after both refits

gates.PAIR_VALIDATION: auto from the pair terminal (gates.pair_status PASS)
gates.PROCEDURE_FREEZE: auto after pair PASS (identities, family hashes, strategy version, costs, seed, cadence, final-fit policy)
gates.VALIDATION_DELIVERY: auto when every outbox item is DELIVERED and MIRRORS.json VERIFIED
gates.DATA_PROVENANCE: external, data lane; evidence.final_bundles {final_short_bundle, final_long_bundle: {relpath, sha256}} feeds the final refits
gates.STRATEGY_OWNER_RULINGS: external, owner: barrier_equality, costs_and_pip_value, fill_model, sharpe_convention, min_long_heads

readiness: READY | BLOCKED {missing:[{gate, artifact, owner, reason}]} | TERMINAL {disposition: PAIR_NOT_ELIGIBLE | UNIT_FAILED:<id> | ...}

child_protocol.fit/final_refit: unit_runner runs `python -m tools.i6dmo.train --design <attempt>/design.json --bundle <data_root>/<pin.relpath parent> --out <out>/train --device gpu|cpu --json`; RECEIPT.json -> TERMINAL.json (exit 2/3/4 -> typed FAILED terminal, never retried; 137/124 -> FAILED_OOM/FAILED_TIMEOUT); PROGRESS.json -> progress.json
child_protocol.report: hook tools.i6dmo.reporting.run_unit(spec, out_dir, progress_path) -> terminal dict  (NOT YET OWNED: data lane naive.paired_metrics + weekly_diagnostics on model predictions/validation.npz; must emit eligibility {h: {mae, naive, eligible, n}} and governed reports)
child_protocol.pair/final_test: hook tools.i6dmo.strategy_adapter.run_unit(spec, out_dir, progress_path) -> terminal dict (strategy lane: pair_eligibility then run_backtest; must set gates {pair_status, strategy_version, costs_sha256})
child_protocol.terminal: schema i6dmo.terminal.v1: unit_id, identity_sha256, status COMPLETE|FAILED|NOT_ELIGIBLE|PAIR_NOT_ELIGIBLE, disposition, artifacts {name: {path, sha256}}, costs {wall_seconds, fit_seconds, score_seconds, cgroup_peak_bytes, gpu_uuid}, eligibility, gates, reports[]
child_protocol.missing_hook_or_bundle: worker marks WAIT_ARTIFACT (cause names module/pin and owner) before claiming: no attempt is burned

data_pins: private JSON passed to init: {short_bundle: {relpath, sha256 of BUNDLE.json}, long_bundle: {...}}; relpath is under each GPU role's data_root
identity: sha256 of {unit, family, kind, cadence (NONE|QUARTERLY|MONTHLY|WEEKLY), family effective sha, data_sha256, code_commit, seed, upstream identities}; adoption only by an exact, re-verified stored terminal
admission: cap = max(refused cap for the unit, ceil(1.25 x measured peak of that device class and kind) else launcher.initial_cap_bytes); requires MemAvailable >= cap + reserve, slice >= cap, disk >= 20 GiB, GPU visible with >= 2 GiB free, no foreign heavy (>=1 GiB) GPU process on the host; preferred (lowest order) GPU role first; a later role takes a GPU unit only after earlier roles refused it or hold a heavy lease; one heavy lease per host_key
private_deployment_spec: documented in tools/i6dmo/deploy.py PRIVATE_SPEC_DOC; never committed
deploy_sequence: source <private bootstrap>   # defines I6DMO_PRIVATE_SPEC and I6DMO_ROOT (render-bootstrap)

python -m tools.i6dmo init --design docs/i6n/direct_multi_output_static/EXPERIMENT.short.json --deployment "$I6DMO_PRIVATE_SPEC" --root "$I6DMO_ROOT" --data-pins <private pins.json> [--long-design <sealed long design>]
python -m tools.i6dmo gate --root "$I6DMO_ROOT" --name SOFTWARE_TRACEABILITY --receipt <TRACEABILITY receipt json>   # when true; DATA_PROVENANCE and STRATEGY_OWNER_RULINGS by their owners
python -m tools.i6dmo status --root "$I6DMO_ROOT" --level campaign --json   # once; then fleet: --level fleet
verify_once_after_deploy: status --level fleet: running unit on the preferred role with device rtx5090 and its GPU uuid in UNIT_SPEC.json
no other heavy attempt on the preferred host_key
